articles.summary: - Third Quarter Net Sales increased 11% to $2.4 Billion - Third Quarter GAAP EPS of $0.74, decreased 10.8%, and Adjusted EPS(1) of $1.04, increased 9.5% - Strong Third Quarter Cash Flows from Operations of $349 Million Somnigroup International Inc. (NYSE: SGI, "Company") announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 and revised financial guidance for the full year 2026. On August 26, 2026, the Company completed its previously announced acquisition of Leggett Platt, Incorporated ("Leggett Platt"). The Company's 2026 third quarter financials include Leggett Platt's operations for the period from August 26, 2026 through September 30, 2026 (the "stub period"). articles.summary: Somnigroup International Inc. (NYSE: SGI, "Company" or "Somnigroup") today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a fourth quarter cash dividend on its common stock of $0.17 per share. The dividend is payable on December 7, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 23, 2026. About Somnigroup International Inc. Somnigroup (NYSE: SGI) is the world's leading bedding company, dedicated to transforming how the world sleeps. With superior capabilities in design, component and finished goods manufacturing, distribution and retail, we deliver breakthrough sleep solutions and serve the evolving needs of consumers in more than 100 countries worldwide through our fully-owned businesses, Tempur Sealy, Mattress Firm, Leggett Platt and Dreams. Our portfolio includes the most highly recognized brands in the industry, including Tempur-Pedic®, Sealy®, Stearns Foster®, and Sleepy's®, enhanced by Leggett Platt's diversified component engineering expertise.
